svg.aria-label: What a step spends its time on. A prefill token costs 4.31 milliseconds because 34 tokens share one pass over the weights. A steady decode token costs 12.50 milliseconds, of which 12.98 is the forward pass and 0.09 is the sampler. The graph build costs 0.4 milliseconds once and is 3.1 percent of a single decode step.
svg.text: WHAT A STEP SPENDS ITS TIME ON
one model, one context: the engine's own `MINFER_TIMING` split, medians of three runs
a prefill token - 4.31 ms, 34 tokens sharing one pass
the forward pass: 12.98 ms, 99.2 per cent
of which the sampler - 0.09 ms, 0.8 per cent
that six-pixel block is the whole sampler, drawn as wide as it is
the graph build, once per shape
0.4 ms, and 3.1 per cent of one decode step
A step is the forward pass. The sampler is 0.09 ms of 12.5, and the build is paid once in 24 steps, so a
loop that rebuilt every step would still spend most of its time in the model - which is why the reuse
cache's real payoff is structural (a warm pool, a capturable graph, a second session), not the 3 per cent.
what a prefill token buys at 2.5x a decode token's speed: one read of the weights for 34 tokens instead of one per token.
